_v6_conditional_terms.why: two v6 terms are conditional and are named rather than folded into a figure a replication is expected to spend: §12.6's expansion stops the moment C1-C6 pass, and the Gate-2.75 probe stops the moment m* passes its margin

_v6_note: Confirmatory cost is n_cells x N_BLOCKS x M_DRAWS and nothing else. The v6 proposal's '~110,000 confirmatory' was v5's CALIBRATION burden (110,736) quoted in the wrong row; on D1's registered 56-cell option the confirmatory figure is 56 x 384 x 8 = 172,032 per replication. Every number here is computed, none is transcribed.
